title: Omnitrix exploration and exploitation: findings and repair log
scope: Assess research quality across code, exported logs and metrics. Deterministic checks establish capabilities and safeguards; autonomous live trials establish model behavior separately.

issues.title: Inventory hides resources after the first 40 directory entries
issues.baseline: Manager list_resources truncates before filtering runtime directories, has no cursor, and returns filesystem order.
issues.fix: Sorted inventory, filtering before pagination, paths, resource kinds, byte sizes, explicit scan limits.

issues.title: Large logs are inaccessible and source contents cannot be searched
issues.baseline: A 198 KiB log with the critical clue at its tail is rejected while planning because sources are capped at 128 KiB.
issues.fix: Streaming revision hashes and bounded, paginated source search and reads, with explicit limits.

issues.title: No numerical tool compares aggregate cost across metrics
issues.baseline: Researchers can read short excerpts but cannot aggregate CSV measurements, making frequency and impact easy to confuse.
issues.fix: Paginated CSV aggregation recording counts, sums, ranges, invalid values and incomplete coverage as citable evidence.

issues.title: No visible coverage or unexplored frontier for reprioritization
issues.status: Coverage view implemented; live search behavior remains incomplete
issues.baseline: Opportunity scores reward evidence confidence; the manager has no concise view of unexamined planned sources, signal classes, or concentration.
issues.fix: Expose observed source coverage, untouched scoped resources, unresolved opportunities and exploration advice; instruct manager to compare alternatives and seek contradictions.
issues.verification: Coverage and manager context tests plus autonomous evaluation harness

issues.title: Independent review can approve with citations unrelated to the claims
issues.baseline: gate returns supported when claim cites db but evaluator cites cache. save_findings leaves it unverified, yet the job remains supported and can enable implementation authorization.
issues.fix: Require evaluator evidence coverage for every factual claim before accepting the job.

issues.title: Duplicate detection can return a different goal's job
issues.baseline: Research signatures omit goal ID despite goal-specific jobs, budgets and acceptance criteria.
issues.fix: Scope duplicate lookup to the current goal while preserving knowledge retrieval across goals.

issues.title: No HTML tracking report
issues.baseline: Only CLI/JSON export exists; no persistent human-readable findings and fix history.
issues.fix: Escaped standalone HTML reports for evaluation history and per-goal evidence/decision logs.
issues.verification: test_html_report_escapes_source_text and CLI export smoke test

issues.title: Live research access prerequisites
issues.status: Resolved: credentials propagated and API network access now works
issues.baseline: Initially OPENAI_API_KEY was absent, then the egress proxy rejected api.openai.com with CONNECT HTTP 403. These attempts executed no model reasoning.
issues.fix: Reused the secure environment credential after propagation; saved the api.openai.com network addition. Subsequent unauthenticated API probe reached HTTP 401 and actual model trials executed.
issues.verification: live-connected-01 and live-connected-02 contain real manager decisions and specialist reports

issues.title: Live manager stops at the first inventory page and underfunds research
issues.status: Partially improved; log-tail coverage and replacement-hypothesis support remain open
issues.baseline: Original code: 0/8 checks and premature pause. First tool-improved live case: 0/8 with pause after first 40 entries. Negative control: 3/8; repeated 1-2 call probes sampled cache-only prefixes and never reached decisive code, CSV rows or log tail.
issues.fix: Provide observed root inventory in manager context, surface subdirectory names/counts beyond current page, resolve conflicting delegation guidance, and require budgets suited to whole-file comparisons.
issues.verification: Live iteration 04: 6/8 buried-bottleneck checks, 5/8 negative-control checks. Iteration 05: 5/8 each. Trials are development cases used during tuning, not a held-out estimate.

issues.title: Discovery can complete without making a single source observation
issues.status: Reproduced live; guard and tool activation implemented
issues.baseline: Iteration 02 produced two discovered reports with zero discretionary tool calls and empty citations, followed by a pause.
issues.fix: Require an initial discovery/research tool call and reject discovery without current observed evidence.
issues.verification: test_discovery_cannot_complete_without_observing_any_evidence; subsequent live trials performed actual source/tool reads.

issues.title: Prefix-only metric reasoning and missed log-tail evidence
issues.status: CSV continuation implemented; broader behavioral limitation remains
issues.baseline: Live researcher/evaluator treated cache-only CSV prefixes as evidence that other operation types were unmeasured.
issues.fix: Observed CSV column metadata; initial numeric aggregation for numeric CSV scopes; SDK aggregation follows pages within tool budget, preserving incomplete status.
issues.remaining: Some live runs still skip logs, fail to reach decisive log-tail events, or stop after falsification rather than independently verifying the alternative. Do not claim full exploration/exploitation balance.

issues.title: Self-audit native worker blocked by masked daemon socket
issues.status: Socket startup resolved; bounded native run timed out before verification
issues.baseline: Native shells failed because the outer sandbox masks the daemon socket directory. No edits occurred in that attempt; independent oracles failed.
issues.fix: Run self-audit outside the outer command sandbox through the approved execution route; Codex retains its own workspace sandbox.
issues.verification: Self-audit live-03 performed real edits, spent 300 seconds on the native turn and stopped with an uncertain candidate. No passing verification or final audit is claimed; reconciliation is underway.

issues.title: Native implementation exceeds its bounded turn without verified completion
issues.baseline: Self-audit live-03 reached accepted research and real edits but timed out before candidate verification. Latest native usage snapshot: 603768 input tokens (566912 cached), 3869 output tokens. These are cumulative usage values, not unique prompt bytes or a dollar estimate.
issues.remaining: The app correctly retains uncertainty and prevents replay/completion. Automatic implementation quality and efficiency remain unresolved; a successful human-led PR must not be counted as an autonomous end-to-end success.

issues.title: Evaluation process could exit zero with failed research checkpoints
issues.baseline: The initial harness used exit status only to distinguish runtime exceptions; a completed conversation with 0/8 or 5/8 checks could still exit zero. Those recorded scores remain failures regardless of historical command exit codes.
issues.fix: Exit 0 only for all checkpoints passed, 1 for behavioral failure/no trials, 2 for blocked/error.
